div.p: Founded in 1892, Axion University has grown from a small liberal arts college into one of the world's foremost research universities — committed to academic excellence, social equity, and the relentless pursuit of discovery.

To advance knowledge through rigorous scholarship, empower students of all backgrounds to lead meaningful lives, and contribute solutions to the most pressing challenges facing humanity and our planet.

To be the world's most innovative, inclusive, and impactful university — where curiosity is celebrated, collaboration is the norm, and every discovery has a pathway to change the world for the better.
We cultivate critical thinking, evidence-based reasoning, and the courage to question established assumptions in every field.
Every student, faculty member, and staff deserves to belong. Diversity of thought, background, and experience makes our scholarship stronger.
Our graduates lead institutions, build companies, and drive policy in 130+ countries. Axion's influence extends far beyond our campus.

div.h6: Founding as Axion Liberal Arts College
div.p: Established by philanthropist Edmund H. Axion with an initial enrollment of 87 students across four disciplines: classics, science, theology, and law.
Following the founding of the Graduate School of Engineering and the School of Medicine, the state legislature granted full university status. Enrollment reached 4,000.
Professor Eleanor Marsh received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for her groundbreaking work on enzyme catalysis — the first of 14 Nobel Prizes awarded to Axion scholars.
The 200-acre Innovation Campus launched with 12 research institutes and partnerships with 30 founding industry partners, establishing Axion as a world research leader.
Axion passed $1B in endowment and launched international campuses in London, Singapore, and São Paulo, serving 5,000+ students across 4 continents.

div.h6: Ranked #1 in Innovation — QS World Rankings
div.p: With 48,000 students, $400M in annual research funding, and 500,000+ alumni across 130 countries, Axion enters its next century as a global leader in education and discovery.

div.p: Axion University is committed to building a campus where every person — regardless of race, gender, nationality, religion, disability, or socioeconomic background — can thrive. Diversity is not a goal; it is a core dimension of our academic excellence.
div.div: Equity & Access: Axion's Need-Blind Admissions policy ensures that financial need never disqualifies a qualified applicant. 38% of undergraduate students receive need-based grants averaging $28,000 per year.
